Best Keto Pancakes

These fluffy keto pancakes are perfect for a low-carb breakfast.

Servings: 8 pancakes Prep: 5 minutes Cook: 10 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2 oz cream cheese, softened
  • 2 large eggs
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 2 tbsp almond flour
  • 1 packet stevia
  • 1/2 tsp cinnamon
  • Butter for cooking

Instructions

  1. Blend cream cheese, eggs, vanilla, almond flour, stevia, and cinnamon until smooth.
  2. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add butter.
  3. Pour small circles of batter and cook 2 minutes per side.
  4. Serve with sugar-free syrup or berries.

Nutrition per serving

Calories: 80, Fat: 6g, Protein: 4g, Carbs: 1g
